title: UpdateStatus
description: GET /api/v1/admin/update (since 1.13): the update of the installation, as the watcher outside the server last wrote it.

watching.description: Whether a watcher is running (it wrote its status lately).

running.description: Whether an update is running now.

requested.description: Whether an update was asked for and not taken yet.

updateAvailable.description: Whether the watcher saw a commit other than the one that runs.

canRequest.description: Whether an update can be asked for now (a watcher, none running or asked for).

runningCommit.description: The commit the server was built from, null when not known.

branch.description: The branch the watcher follows, null when not known.

upstream.description: What it compares with, null when not known.

remoteCommit.description: The newest commit it saw, null when not known.

fetchFailed.description: Whether its last look for something newer failed.

checked.description: When it last looked (ISO 8601), null for never.

lastRun.description: When the last update ran (ISO 8601), null for never.

lastRunOk.description: Whether the last update succeeded, null for none.
